notes.text: Section, act Jan. 27, 1938, ch. 11, § 2, 52 Stat. 8, related to disclosure by employee of information. See section 1905 of Title 18, Crimes and Criminal Procedure.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Section 20 of act June 25, 1948, provided that the repeal of this section shall be effective Sept. 1, 1948.
